items.q: What is the core distinction between a second brain and an AIOS?
items.a: In the **Four Cs**, **Context + Connections = second brain** (knowledge); **Capabilities + Cadence = AIOS** (infrastructure on top). Without a second brain, you cannot have an AI operating system.

items.q: Where does an OS actually start?
items.a: Not with architecture diagrams — **"an OS starts with a default"** harness (Claude Code). Close the tabs and stop repeating yourself across ChatGPT projects.

items.q: How do you gut-check whether your system works?
items.a: Ask Claude Code about your business: does the answer sound like a **stranger**, or like a **teammate / co-founder**?

items.q: What role does CLAUDE.md play in Herk 2?
items.a: It is the **routing tree** — wiki paths, hot cache, master index, skills, sub-agents, and API key locations — so the agent can find things without long searches.

items.q: Why nest "other worlds" inside the main AIOS?
items.a: Frequently used repos (YouTube OS, book, website) live inside Herk 2 for **single-repo GitHub sync** and unified agent reach across projects.

items.q: When should data be markdown vs live API?
items.a: Use wiki/markdown for **background knowledge**; pull **APIs/CLIs** for changing numbers — e.g. stale **620k** subscriber stats vs live **800k**.

items.q: How should you run assembly-line sessions?
items.a: Phase work: research → `/clear` → draft → `/clear` → polish — **one AI, one job per phase**. Turn repeated prompts into skills; every run is feedback data.

items.q: How expensive is Claude Fable under stress?
items.a: About **2× Opus** pricing (**$10/M in, $50/M out**); a stress test can burn a **$200/mo Max 5-hour window in ~1 hour**. Use Fable for orchestration; Sonnet/Haiku for parallel sub-tasks.

items.q: Why are keys more important than prompts for automation?
items.a: **"A prompt is never a permission layer"** — assume **if it can, it will**. Scoped API keys are the real gate; illustrated by a mistaken bulk email to **150–200k** subscribers.

items.q: What IP survives model and harness churn?
items.a: **Folders, markdown, skills, and routing logic** — you're building a personal OS, not a Claude-Code-only artifact. At ~**40k tokens** on `/context`, scale had not been a problem yet.
